text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a stock just because I have a gain; selling Stock B at 123.61 and buying it back at 140.69 showed how quickly I can miss out and re-enter at a worse price.","I should judge each holding by its future prospects and the whole portfolio, not by whether it is above my average cost; avoiding a loss is not a good reason to keep holding.","Before trading, I should ask whether the decision still makes sense after costs and risks; repeated small trades like my Stock D round trip can add activity without adding much value."]}
